hypothesis: Changing positional piece width may change optimized structure and reconstruction resources; a useful trade-off is not assumed.
selection: report-only; no runtime, size, CPU or memory ceiling
interpretation: Compare successful reconstruction costs only when both candidate and baseline succeeded at the same budget.
Retain failed answers, unsupported exports, observer timeouts and grading gaps separately.
Application slowdowns and increased instruction counts alone are not protection benefits.
Identical compiled artifacts are negative controls for resource-cost claims.
Repeated trials measure noise on the same artifacts; they are not independent program samples.
Reserved algorithm families, multi-location memory inference and human effort are outside this comparison.
